items.title: AI-written peer reviews outscored top human experts
items.summary: Artificial intelligence may now write more useful feedback on unpublished research papers than well-paid human experts. In blind comparisons, both an AI judge and former journal editors preferred the AI-written reviews in the large majority of cases.
items.interpretation: 这条消息值得关注的地方，是它揭示的行业趋势：技术创新正在从实验室走向真实业务、监管和规模化落地。
